entities.summary: Sergey Ivanovich Spasokukotsky was a Russian and Soviet surgeon and a member of the Academy of Sciences of the Soviet Union since 1942. He was awarded the Stalin Prize for his monograph Lung actinomycosis, along with distinctions.
